sources.title: Planning Inspector issues Local Plan letter after public hearings
sources.verified_claim: The Planning Inspector issued a post-hearing letter; Enfield Council says the findings recommend removing certain development sites from the Green Belt and that the Council will review next steps.
sources.note: High-authority current policy context only; not exact parcel evidence.

sources.title: Leader's Statement: Beam Park Station update
sources.verified_claim: Havering Council states Beam Park Station is much needed and would enable housing and business growth in the area; the Council is supporting GLA and partners on funding solutions.
sources.note: Current council growth/infrastructure context; exact sample intersection still requires hashed live query evidence.

sources.title: Site Allocations Development Plan Document
sources.verified_claim: Lambeth Council received the Inspector's Report on 3 March 2026; the SADPD contains site-specific planning policies for 13 proposed allocation sites and is intended to support new homes and workspaces.
sources.note: Current primary plan-status evidence; sample parcel applicability remains unproven.
